independent_checks.scope: Lightweight synthetic join_case/terminal invariants only; no producer fixtures or suite imported.

findings: Full verified-applicable reference set is retained across all27 cells; unavailable observations stay in denominator and become UNKNOWN, not measured misses.
Exact chain/hash join does not attribute an adjacent/grouped execution notification to another reference.
Known-subset point coverage is labeled as subset coverage; complete incident miss requires positive inventory closure, nonempty verified positives and no unavailable applicable reference.
An existing verified selected observation remains usable when an additional reference source audit reports UNAVAILABLE; no-core assertions contradicting selected evidence are rejected.
Unavailable complete run metrics are null; nonreference notifications remain UNKNOWN rather than false positives.
All eight terminal categories partition the synthetic positive inventory in semantic arms, with consistent nested funnel and full-denominator bounds.
Reference acquisition follows both closed decision stages, and separate named review is bound to exact candidate records; hash consistency does not establish audit truth.
limitations: No actual incident reference or primary-source factual adjudication was performed.
The independent code review does not replace the separate audit of actual decisions, source evidence, reference identity or inventory closure.
Only three new targeted synthetic invariant tests were executed; the producer14 and old suites were not rerun.
